why: Put the first two figures of a row together: any part that is the same in both is removed, the other parts stay. In row 3 the up arrow is in both, so it goes away; the left and right arrows and the two diagonal arrows stay. That is option 1. Option 2 still keeps the up arrow.
trick: Rule "same parts cancel, different parts stay" is very common in 3x3 grids; check it on row 1 first.
